style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

The ⟦0⟧ starts with a small and under-equipped army, as well as a small air force. It does not possess a navy. The available manpower is heavily restricted by the ⟦1⟧ national spirit.
* marks a division that is removed in the 1939 start. ^ marks a division that is only available in the 1939 start.
The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.

Your main aim as the Raj in historical multiplayer is to defend against ⟦0⟧ for as long as possible. How this is best done depends on the game's rules, active DLCs, and how ⟦1⟧ acts in their war against ⟦2⟧. A ⟦3⟧ that blazes through ⟦4⟧ to conquer it quickly will have access to more ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧ for longer but will tend to have less experienced ⟦7⟧ due to the lack of ⟦8⟧ opportunities, while a ⟦9⟧ that takes their time will tend to have far more powerful ⟦10⟧ and ⟦11⟧ from ⟦12⟧, and therefore far better stats on their units, at the cost of delaying their access to the rather substantial Chinese industrial base. Time is also usually on the Allies' side, so the longer it takes for ⟦13⟧ to declare war, the easier it should be to deal with them once they have.

Without ⟦0⟧, the Raj has a smaller focus tree, with focuses that are both lengthy and relatively weak compared to other nations'. It is important to make the most of the tree, focusing on unlocking their third research slot and gaining enough war support to pass ⟦1⟧ early. Rushing to complete ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ may seem wasteful, but they stop and slowly reverse the passive ⟦4⟧ decline Raj experiences from the start of the game, which can allow them to take more investment focuses later without jeopardizing their position. The choice of what to use ⟦5⟧ on can also be important, with ⟦6⟧ usually being such a good candidate that Raj should often rush to try to get that technology as early as possible with the help of that focus. Once WW2 starts, it is imperative to ⟦7⟧ the ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧ to achieve ⟦10⟧ status early enough to complete ⟦11⟧ before the Bengal Famine starts (300 days after WW2 starts), then to eventually become independent and be able to reduce the penalties of Agrarian Society after taking ⟦12⟧. If Raj runs out of ⟦13⟧ to ⟦14⟧, have other Commonwealth nations like ⟦15⟧, ⟦16⟧, and ⟦17⟧ send Raj theirs; the ⟦18⟧ can also ⟦19⟧ them its convoys so that they can forward them to Raj who can send them back to the ⟦20⟧. Achieving ⟦21⟧ status early is also important to be able to complete ⟦22⟧, which, together with ⟦23⟧, will allow Raj to fix their shortage of ⟦24⟧ with newly recruited ones who are often better than the ones with which it starts.
